# Philippa Gordon

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031)</sub>
- **Origin:** Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Role:** College student at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Phil  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Philippa is a very pretty girl with a crooked mouth that flashes into a bewitching smile over white little teeth. She has a pattern of nose inherited from her father's side of the family, though she worries it might develop her mother's traits. She is acknowledged as a beauty and class belle at Redmond.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P38](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0038), [v3 c4 P39](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0039), [v3 c4 P56](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0056), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c6 P13](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0013)_

## Personality

Philippa is lively, bright, and deeply loyal to her friends, lacking any snobbishness despite her wealthy background. She admits to being indecisive and lighthearted, though she possesses a heart of gold and is far less silly than she appears on the surface. She handles situations with good humor, maintaining a cheerful temper and never complaining about the weather.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c4 P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c10 P55](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0055), [v3 c19 P22](../source/v03-c19.md#nw-v03-c19-p0022), [v3 c35 P12](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0012)_

## Goals

- To be chummy with Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant  <sub>[v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060)</sub>
- To marry Jonas Blake despite family opposition  <sub>[v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>

## History

Philippa met Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant during her first days as a Freshman at Redmond College in Kingsport, quickly forging a close friendship with them. Because of her beauty, charm, and high social standing, she easily gained entry into all circles at Redmond and brought Anne and Priscilla along with her. During her first year, she struggled to choose between two suiters back home named Alec and Alonzo. Later, she moved into Patty's Place along with Anne, Priscilla, and Stella, enjoying life as a college coed while studying Mathematics. Despite her mother's initial objections and desire for a wealthy match, Philippa fell in love with a minister named Jonas (Jo) Blake, standing firm until her family accepted him. She was married to Jonas in Bolingbroke with Anne serving as her bridesmaid.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c4 P60](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0060), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c7 P51](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0051), [v3 c10 P54](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0054), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c25 P18](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0018), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_
